description: Every year, Monica looks forward to joining One Colorado’s Prism Awards. The Prism Awards is One Colorado’s annual gala to honor individuals and organizations who have made a substantive difference in the lives of LGBTQIA+ Coloradans and their families. Join hundreds of LGBTQIA+ Coloradans, allies
